cases.message: OpenMed could not complete the request. Retry once and report the error code if it recurs.
The request input is malformed. Pass text in the documented format and retry.
The OpenMed configuration is incomplete. Configure the required option and retry.
The requested capability is unavailable. Select an installed backend or install the required extra.
The optional runtime is unavailable. Install it with `pip install openmed[mcp]` and retry.
The model could not be loaded. Verify the model identifier and local files, then retry.
The request violates the selected privacy policy. Choose a permitted action or update the policy configuration.
The request exceeded its configured budget. Reduce the input or increase the request budget, then retry.
OpenMed encountered an internal invariant failure. Stop processing and report the error code.
The inference backend returned an invalid result. Retry with a compatible model and report the error code if it recurs.
